targets.descriptor: The printed area fills most of the front torso, running from just below the neckband to a little above the hem and stopping well inside the side seams: an arched wordmark in a red-at-top to yellow-at-bottom vertical gradient sits over a squared full-colour photographic panel showing figures with instruments amid lit candles and pale flowers, its edges blurred and slightly grainy so the panel fades into the dark body rather than ending on a hard border. Construction lines are made visible by contrast lighter stitching: a run along the shoulder line and around the armholes, a second line stepping down the outer upper sleeve, and a doubled line at both the sleeve ends and the straight lower hem. The body reads squared through the chest and waist with the hem edge standing slightly off the hip rather than following it, and the neck is finished with a narrow flat rib band seamed with the same contrast thread.

targets.descriptor: Only the waist-to-upper-thigh section is in frame: a wide straight-cut waistband with evenly spaced belt loops, a centre-front fly seam, and curved hip pocket openings whose edges are pushed out of shape by both hands being inserted. Contrast lighter-orange topstitching runs along the waistband edges, the fly line and the pocket curves, and the yoke/side seams read as flat felled runs. The seat and hip carry loose fabric that breaks into large soft diagonal folds across the thigh, and the frame ends before any of the leg line, so how the leg falls below the thigh cannot be traced.
